title: Pairing state response
description: 200 response of POST /v1/pair/{pid}/reject and POST /v1/pair/{pid}/burn: the state the rendezvous is in afterwards. A reject leaves it open (for the phone's next attempt) unless it was the third, which ends it; a burn always ends it. `expired` is a state the desktop is told about here; to the phone it is one 404.
